notes.title: Tiny Titan Studios Update - New Game!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're excited to let you know about our newest game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1135230/Ember_Knights/]Ember Knights[/url]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BL7TJzw.gif[/img]

Ember Knights is a multiplayer dungeon crawling rogue-lite with exciting hack and slash combat! 

[h3]Worlds are falling[/h3]
For reasons unknown, Praxis, Keeper of Reality, has descended into madness. Harnessing the power of the Great Flame, Praxis has mobilized destructive forces to keystone worlds. Fearing the end of these worlds, the remaining energy of the Flame has been used to summon the [b]Ember Knights[/b], legendary guardians of reality. 

Adventure solo or in teams up to 4 to defeat the evil armies, restore the mythical power of the Flame and learn the real truth behind the mad God's tyranny.

[previewyoutube=Hgs3MaE66s0;full][/previewyoutube]

Ember Knights is currently available to wishlist and we're working hard on having a demo ready for mid-late April!

Thanks for checking it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1135230

notes.title: Bless the Rails in Africa! Update 1.2.0 - Release Notes
notes.notes:
Welcome to Africa! Visit countless cities, find unique moments, and continue your great train journey as the Tiny Rails story continues!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30159188/3bade52d78c4fa9230e9bef69dda1bbbebd68069.png[/img]

[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Questline! Take your train on the race of a lifetime and explore the vast continent of Africa! From the Serengeti Plain to the Kalahari Desert, there's something to see in every corner! 
[*] New Depot, Port and Factories!
[*] Checklists have made their way to Steam! Travel around North America completing tasks for awesome rewards! 
[*] Major and minor bug fixes, including lumber fix (read below) 
[/list]
[i]Note[/i]: We are doing a test run with checklists in North America only. We believe this system will make progression in-game more enjoyable for players. As this is a test, we want all of your feedback on this new system so please let us know what you think!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]

[*]South America track and station building has been fixed. Stations should no longer be listed as San Diego.
[*]Golden Gate Bridge moment is now awarded to your moment collection
[*]Lumber issue has been resolved. Please see our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/TinyRails/comments/7f7q89/the_lumber_bug_and_you/] Reddit thread[/url] for more information on why you may still be having temporary issues with it, as it's all explained there.
[*]Various performance, display and quality improvements, including a fix for Mac monitor resolutions.

[/list]
We hope that you'll enjoy this update! Please continue to post your feedback, questions and concerns in the community hub!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30159188/f2ae17fd421a09245616e0bb003c712a84acdca8.jpg[/img]

Update 1.1.0 has arrived for Steam users! Here's a brief list of the major changes:

Content:

• South America has been added as a playable area
• New quest line, story elements and characters - race to find the lost city of El Dorado!
• Pick your path through the new continent with new Station Building and Track Building mechanics

Adjustments:

• Steam Cloud has now been surfaced with a Restore Data button in the options menu; local data is backed up to the cloud on station arrival, after completing Gumball Machine rolls and on quit - Restore Data will load the most recent game save backed up via this method
• Players can now double click and hold to boost for longer periods
• Engines and cabooses are now be equipped/swapped by double clicking on the desired engine/caboose in Train Edit
• Optimized Map, Trainiary and Train Edit screens for better and more reliable performance
• Updated market refresh service behavior
• Updated cargo behavior in markets to improve refreshes and cause quest cargo to spawn consistently while jobs/quests are active
• Excess quest cargo can now be sold to keep it from becoming stuck in player inventory

Fixes:

• Demand cargo should no longer be able to be purchased at a station that has a demand for that specific item
• Demand cargo is now be able to be sold to stations once the initial demand is met
• Players can now properly access the USA West port
• Passenger HUD number sprite no longer scales in size
• Arcade Car now properly display wheels
• Players can now arrive at the Warsaw, Poland station consistently
• Gold collection visuals should now accurately display gold values as currency is collected
• Discarding cars should no longer cause UI to become unresponsive in Train Edit in certain situations
• Assorted location names and grammatical issues in game text
• Various small bugs and performance tweaks

Known Issues:

• Weather is affecting performance in various situations and will be addressed in a future update
• Stars are sometimes visible when they shouldn't be during transitions from day/night and weather effects
• There are z-sorting issues in certain background elements that can cause flickering

notes.title: Tiny Rails South America Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30159188/1933eaffa891ed311416594ff52e92433c6869a7.jpg[/img]
Hello, Steam Community!

We posted recently about the content and bug fix update we were working on, with a goal of releasing last week. As many of you have noticed or pointed out, that goal didn't come to pass. We apologize for over-promising and under-delivering - it wasn't our intent to "Molyneux" anyone.

The fact is, the update wasn't to our standards and we weren't content releasing it until we'd had more time to address it. We're doing so now and will endeavor to get it into your waiting arms as quickly as possible.

We're grateful for your patience and your passion for our game. We most certainly haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to give you an update you'll be happy with.

notes.title: Tiny Rails South America Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30159188/1933eaffa891ed311416594ff52e92433c6869a7.jpg[/img]
Hello, Steam Community!

We posted recently about the content and bug fix update we were working on, with a goal of releasing last week. As many of you have noticed or pointed out, that goal didn't come to pass. We apologize for over-promising and under-delivering - it wasn't our intent to "Molyneux" anyone.

The fact is, the update wasn't to our standards and we weren't content releasing it until we'd had more time to address it. We're doing so now and will endeavor to get it into your waiting arms as quickly as possible.

We're grateful for your patience and your passion for our game. We most certainly haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to give you an update you'll be happy with.

notes.title: Tiny Rails Update News
notes.notes:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30159188/f2ae17fd421a09245616e0bb003c712a84acdca8.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30159188/b455905e98589f21346cf4a5e95f9cb33e1be148.jpg[/img][/url]

Hello, Steam Community!

Firstly, allow us to apologize for things being quiet on the Steam front over the past couple of weeks. We've spent a great deal of time streamlining our production process on the technical side to allow us to more quickly roll content updates to multiple platforms. The long and short of it is we want to ensure we're updating to Steam regularly and we've built some architecture to help us achieve that goal.

The good news is that we're right around the corner from said update! We've got a pile of fixes and adjustments to handle some frequently-encountered bugs, and we're also rolling out some new content for you! South America will be added to the game, with a new, globe-spanning adventure, new characters, and a brand new station building mechanic that will allow you to take a more active role in building your business in the new continent. 

We're targeting a release for [b]next week[/b], and we're excited to share our new additions with you.

Thank you, as always, for your feedback and your passion for our game. Your support is very much appreciated and we're looking forward to being able to keep a steadier flow of updates coming to our Steam players.

notes.title: Hotfixed the Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

So our last hotfix required a hotfix as some of you may know. We resolved the issues relating to save data from our last hotfix and you should be able to continue on using your current save. As with the last hotfix, this includes the 60 fps limit (temporary fix) as well as the map scroll progress bug fix.

If you encounter any more issues at all please let us know on the Discussions board or email our support team at support@tinytitanstudios.com

notes.title: Tiny Rails Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've just put out a hotfix containing a fix to the area map progress bug as well as limited the FPS to 60 as a temporary measure while we get some features implemented to allow users to control the FPS to what they would like.

This is not in place of a full patch, which will be coming down the pipeline soon!

notes.title: A welcome to new players and a request
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30159188/1933eaffa891ed311416594ff52e92433c6869a7.jpg[/img]

Hello, Steam Community!

We wanted to take a moment to welcome our new players and thank all of you for your support.

Please, if you can, take a moment to leave a review? These are incredibly useful to us for feedback purposes and we'd love to hear what your thoughts are.

We've been overwhelmed by the response to the game and we're doing our best to get caught up on community threads and bug reports. Thank you for your patience, and rest assured, we're logging all of your reports and working towards fixing the issues you've noticed.

Thanks again!

notes.title: Feedback Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30159188/1933eaffa891ed311416594ff52e92433c6869a7.jpg[/img]
Hello, again, Steam Community!

We wanted to take a moment to thank all of you for purchasing the game, leaving your amazing reviews and providing bug reports and feedback on the community page. The response has been overwhelmingly positive and we're humbled by your passion for our little pixel train game. We're looking forward to making it even better in the coming weeks and months.

We're currently working on sorting out our production schedule to account for content being added to the Steam version, as well as assessing bug reports to determine priority and time frames for fixes.

We'd also love to hear more from you about the general gameplay of Tiny Rails. We've added and altered a number of gameplay elements of the game and we want to know how players feel about them, whether they've tried the mobile title or not.

Again, our most sincere thanks... keep that feedback coming!

notes.title: Launch Day Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
It's launch day for Tiny Rails on Steam Early Access! We've had a lot of great feedback from our Steam users already and look forward to seeing much more over the coming days and weeks.

Please post any bug reports with reproduction steps in the Bug Thread via our community page.

Thanks to all of you for your support and passion for our game. All aboard!

notes.title: Launch Day is Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Hello, Steam Community!

Just a reminder that Tiny Rails will be hitting Steam Early Access tomorrow morning! The team is incredibly excited to be launching our first Steam game and we hope both new players and TR veterans alike will find something to enjoy in this updated version of our little game. We're very proud of how far the game has come and feel this is the definitive version. We can't wait to have the Steam Community play the game and look forward to making it even better thanks to your feedback. 

We're very appreciative of the support we've had from our fans and we're overjoyed to finally bring the game to you. 

Many thanks,
Tiny Titan Studios

notes.title: Tiny Rails is finally coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello, Steam players!

After our successful Greenlight campaign and a lot of hard work here at the studio, Tiny Rails is finally launching to Steam Early Access on August 8, 2017! We're very proud of the Steam build of the game, and hope that all of our fans, both old and new, will feel as strongly about it was we do.

Be sure to add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss launch! Thank you for your support, everyone!
